subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should the persisted iOS Talk camera selection change the default for every direct node capture that omits `facing`, or only be propagated explicitly for Talk-driven agent captures?
rationale: The current implementation changes the direct iOS fallback while the normal agent path supplies an explicit front-facing value, so neither the product scope nor the public command contract is settled by the code alone.

options.title: Keep direct-node default stable
options.body: Preserve the documented front default for direct omitted-facing calls and add an explicit Talk/agent capture-preference propagation path.

options.title: Adopt a platform-wide preference default
options.body: Allow the persisted preference to govern all omitted iOS camera requests, update the public contract, and add compatibility coverage for integrations.

recommendation.title: Keep direct-node default stable
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented front default for direct omitted-facing calls and add an explicit Talk/agent capture-preference propagation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch owns the concrete iOS camera and Talk integration under discussion, although mainline ownership history was not available in the review context.
